title: Equal probabilities for equal-sized sets
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $k$ be an integer from $0$ through $n$, and let $A,B\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ have the same cardinality. Under the distribution obtained by choosing a uniformly random permutation and taking the set of elements whose images are less than $k$, the probability of obtaining $A$ equals the probability of obtaining $B$.
